game.name: [💧] Sell Water!
game.description:
💧 SELL WATER! 💧

Place Vending Machines! Sell water! Get rich!

🆕 UPDATE: STEAL & SLAP!
🥷 Steal machines from other factories and run them home before the timer runs out
👋 Slap a thief and they drop your machine on the spot
🔒 Lock your factory to keep raiders out
😜 Taunt other players with speech bubbles and emotes (press T)
👑 The #1 player stands beside the leaderboard as a golden statue
🌊 Server-wide WATER RUSH and MEGA RUSH events, now with a countdown

🐄 Cows, cats, dogs and chickens roam the map, give the thirsty ones water for cash
🎁 Send a free daily gift and boost a friend's factory for a reward
📅 Log in every day for bigger streak rewards
🚀 Faster rebirths, with a free machine every time

🥤 Unlock 15 machines, Basic all the way to INFINITY
⭐ Merge two of a kind, a 5⭐ machine earns 700x
🏗️ Belts, collectors, upgraders, build your perfect plot
🧪 Potions for luck, earnings and speed
🎟️ Code RELEASE! for a 2x income potion
